venue: Wastin' Away poolside at Alexis Park Las Vegas

zones.label: General Admission
zones.description: General Admission here is intentionally casual rather than row-based. The show happens around the pool, so guests can settle into the poolside area and enjoy it without a traditional assigned-seat setup.

zones.label: Seating available
zones.badge: You do not have to stand
zones.description: Seating is available along the poolside area for guests who prefer to sit. The setup is still casual, so think chairs around the show area rather than fixed theater rows.
